letter.company_line: Trenchless pipeline and water infrastructure contractor, Scoresby office
letter.subject: Project Coordinator, Scoresby
paragraphs: I am applying for the Project Coordinator role at your Scoresby office, advertised on SEEK. Planning and scheduling construction activities, tracking progress and coordinating crews, equipment and materials for Interflow's trenchless pipeline and water infrastructure work is the kind of hands-on coordination I want to build my career in.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge engineer at JustBuilt on a community hall renovation worth about AUD 22,000, then as field engineer at Grand Travaux on residential subdivision finishing works. I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, passed on work priorities, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, along with cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

I have not yet worked on water, sewer or culvert projects, so I would be learning your methods on the job. I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I would like to talk about how I could support your project managers and field crews. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
